cfr.timestamp_rule: Normalize first video PTS to zero; FFmpeg fps24 round-near/eof-pass preserves the last frame's display interval; duplicate/drop by timestamps, never retime via nominal FPS.

geometry.mode: SAR-normalized display size at source_scale + minimal 16-pixel alignment PAD; no additional fit-to-canvas upscale

audio.offset_alignment: Original audio PTS minus first video PTS; early trim/late silence; nearest-sample duration and zero tail padding.

warnings: Mono source duplicated to stereo by FFmpeg.
Source transfer tags unspecified; treated as SDR. This is not HDR detection from pixel values.
No user frame cap. The full clip and native padding still materialize in host RAM; available RAM/VRAM and the decoder deadline remain finite.
Source aspect is retained with only 16-pixel alignment padding at the explicit source_scale; large inputs/scales can greatly increase RAM/VRAM use.
limits: CPU IMAGE batch is materialized after geometry preparation; this is not streaming temporal H3 refinement or an unlimited-memory path.
Reads the complete underlying upload; connect raw LoadVideo directly. VIDEO-object trim/crop edits are not applied.
PQ/HLG rejected; unknown tags are not a guarantee of SDR mastering.
FIT/PAD applies to input preparation only. A generative refinement model may redraw black bars; exact final letterboxing is not guaranteed.
Output width and height are selected manually in the downstream latent upscale node; this node does not run a model.

frame_cap_rejects_instead_of_trimming: Actual CFR24 decode exceeds max_frames=12. No shortened clip is returned. Shorten externally or explicitly raise the limit for stronger hardware.
